shared_elements: single large anthropomorphic figure filling the field
frontal/profile face with elaborate headdress or crown
patterned garment with fringed or tasselled edges
dense low-relief surface ornament covering the body
raised arm/hand region with held or attached attributes
wing-like or feather-like fanning plumage forms
justification: Both surfaces depict a single dominant standing anthropomorphic figure with an elaborate headdress, richly patterned fringed garment and feather-like fanning forms flanking the body, occupying the whole field in low relief — a broadly comparable 'ornate standing personage' scheme. But the treatments differ sharply: A is a clear-outlined profile figure with anatomically legible arms, beard and bird wings against empty ground, while B is a frontal, densely packed composition of interlocking masks, glyph-like blocks and ornaments in which the body is almost lost, and the specific attributes (bucket-like object, cone) have no counterpart.
